name: mouser
description: Search Mouser parts, review BOMs, build carts and (opt-in) place confirmed orders.
long_description: Part search and BOM review against Mouser's catalog: stock, lead times, lifecycle, RoHS, pricing breaks and compliance codes. Build and edit carts, look up order history. Order placement is off by default; when enabled it requires typing APPROVE into a confirmation prompt shown by the server, which Claude Desktop does not support yet (use Claude Code).

search_api_key.title: Mouser Search API key
search_api_key.description: From the Mouser API hub (My Account → APIs). Needed for part search.

order_api_key.title: Mouser Order API key
order_api_key.description: Optional. Needed for carts, order history and ordering.

enable_orders.title: Enable order placement
enable_orders.description: Off by default. Placing orders needs a client that can show a confirmation prompt (Claude Code); Claude Desktop can't yet.
